decision: Retain NASA thermal functions provisionally; prioritize a same-version ATcT1.228 energy-only candidate. TIPS crossover and high-temperature caloric differences require a separate smooth thermal-model assessment before any replacement.
limitations: Old Gurvich volumes and original JANAF evaluation derivations were not independently reaudited; source attribution and numerical reproduction are narrower claims.
ATcT version changes are evaluated-network differences, not statistically independent measurements; covariance and full physical uncertainty are absent.
One principal isotope partition function plus natural-mass translation is an elemental proxy, not an isotopic mixture.
Finite differences of rounded PF tables are caloric diagnostics with rounding and step checks, not a production derivative model. The direct/product crossover is not smooth.
No new equilibrium substitution; the archived hot gas grid does not establish relevance across all planetary atmospheres.
